rationale: All three lenses ran to completion with full evidence. Acceptance lens confirmed all 9 spec criteria met (declaration shape, DECLARATIONS registration, YAML entry, pattern semantics, and every test called out in the spec's Testing section). One actionable finding survived triage: the new recentReleaseCount field omits max_length (unlike its CHAT_DISCLAIMER sibling, which sets max_length=1000), so an unbounded pattern-valid digit string bypasses clean 400 validation and can fail at the DynamicConfig.value DB column (max_length=10000) with an unhandled error. 5 other lens-raised items were dismissed: two duplicate reports of the optional/empty-override-skips-pattern behavior (pre-existing shared _validate_text semantics already covered by an existing precedent test, not introduced by this diff), the enabled:true default (matches the documented mcpAuthTimeoutSeconds precedent cited in the spec's Background section), a tautological declaration test, and a service-test-file-placement nitpick (functionally correct, just imports the config singleton directly rather than through a service call).

findings.title: recentReleaseCount field has no max_length, unlike its CHAT_DISCLAIMER sibling
findings.problem: RELEASE_NOTES_RECENT_COUNT's recentReleaseCount FieldDeclaration does not set max_length (defaults to None), while CHAT_DISCLAIMER.text sets max_length=1000. The pattern ^[1-9][0-9]*$ bounds digit-only content but not string length, so an arbitrarily long digit string still matches and passes validate_and_sanitize.
findings.impact: An admin override with a very long digit string (thousands of digits) passes field validation but can then fail at the DynamicConfig.value DB column, which is capped at max_length=10000 (src/codemie/rest_api/models/dynamic_config.py:50). Instead of the intended clean 400 'Must be a positive integer' response, this surfaces as an unhandled DB-layer error, inconsistent with how every other declared field in this registry bounds input length.
findings.recommendation: Add a reasonable max_length to the recentReleaseCount FieldDeclaration (a handful of digits is sufficient, since the value is a small display count like 10 or 50) so oversized input is rejected by validate_and_sanitize's normal 400 path instead of reaching the DB layer.
